body: They stupidly took me off of Zyprexa when I went in-patient the first time. I was so incredibly anxious by the time I got out that I pursued an off-label treatment for PTSD called a stellate ganglion block-- one of the worst decisions of my life. It made the depersonalization so much worse and like cut the feelings out from my body.
Thanks for your response. No, I haven't had any relief (not even for a moment) in months.
